_comment: Reasoning support per model, and per provider as a fallback. Nothing is
sent for a model that appears nowhere here, which is the default and the
'param' is the request field: 'reasoning' sends {reasoning: {effort: X}},
values the provider accepts, in the order the UI offers them. 'default' is
sent when the user has not chosen — the policy is to keep reasoning off
where it can be turned off, and ask for the cheapest level where it cannot.
'mandatory' marks a model that reasons whether or not it is asked to; its
traces are shown rather than discarded.
Provider keys must match the provider label shown in the UI.
